violation_type.title: AP Must Place Infants in Face up Sleeping Position or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant (26 TAC §746.2427(a))
violation_type.short_title: AP Must Place Infants in Face up Sleeping Position or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant
violation_type.typical_finding: An infant was observed sleeping on an elevating medical pillow with straps due to having reflux. The infant caregivers stated that two infants use these pillows and that they also use them in their cribs. The infants had doctor's notes but no Infant Sleep Exception forms on file.

finding_variants.text: An infant was observed sleeping on an elevating medical pillow with straps due to having reflux. The infant caregivers stated that two infants use these pillows and that they also use them in their cribs. The infants had doctor's notes but no Infant Sleep Exception forms on file.
One 3 month old child in the infant room was placed on stomach for sleep without doctors safe sleep exception form on file. This is corrected at inspection.
There was sufficient evidence that the operation placed a 17-month-old infant on their stomach at naptime.
Inspector observed one infant 5 months of age asleep on stomach, when inspector spoke to staff they stated they placed the baby on her stomach to sleep.
A two month old, who is unable to roll over was observed sleeping on his stomach.    Note: The caregiver rolled the child to his back when it was brought to her attention.
A 6 month old was placed in their crib on their stomach.

occurrences.finding: AP Must Place Infants in Face up Sleeping Position or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant: Observed two caregivers place two different infants on their stomachs to sleep.
